ex.en: Please tell me how to get to the airport.
ex.zh: 請告訴我怎麼去機場。

ex.en: Please pick me up at the airport at five.
ex.zh: 請在五點到機場接我。

ex.en: He is going to drive you to the airport.
ex.zh: 他會開車載你去機場。

airport.en: a place where planes take off and land

ex.en: He is afraid to fly in an airplane.
ex.zh: 他不敢搭飛機。

ex.en: It's the law: always buckle your safety belt in cars and airplanes.
ex.zh: 這是法律規定：搭汽車和飛機一定要繫安全帶。

ex.en: Tom likes to make paper airplanes.
ex.zh: 湯姆喜歡摺紙飛機。

airplane.en: a vehicle with wings and engines that flies through the air

ex.en: Your school is so kind to reimburse you for the return airfare.
ex.zh: 你們學校真好，還幫你們報銷來回機票。

ex.en: Airfares are usually higher during the holidays.
ex.zh: 假期期間機票通常比較貴。

airfare.en: the cost of a ticket to travel by plane

ex.en: The air we breathe consists of oxygen and nitrogen.
ex.zh: 我們呼吸的空氣是由氧氣和氮氣組成的。

ex.en: Let's go outside and get some fresh air.
ex.zh: 我們出去呼吸點新鮮空氣吧。

air.en: the mix of gases around us that we breathe

ex.en: My father traveled all over the world by air.
ex.zh: 我父親搭飛機環遊過世界。

ex.en: The documents will be sent by air.
ex.zh: 文件會用空運寄出。

air.en: using a plane to travel or send goods

ex.en: I want a compact car with an air conditioner.
ex.zh: 我想要一台有冷氣的小型車。

ex.en: I can't survive without air conditioning in the summer.
ex.zh: 夏天沒有冷氣我活不下去。

air.en: a machine or system that keeps a room cool

ex.en: The show will air next Monday.
ex.zh: 這個節目下週一播出。

ex.en: The interview was aired on TV last night.
ex.zh: 這段訪問昨晚在電視上播出。

air.en: to be shown on television or radio

ex.en: A stable economy is the aim of every government.
ex.zh: 穩定的經濟是每個政府的目標。

ex.en: Their common aim was to make the project successful.
ex.zh: 他們共同的目標是讓這個專案成功。

aim.en: the thing you want to do or get

ex.en: Mayuko always aims for perfection.
ex.zh: 麻由子總是追求完美。

ex.en: We aim to finish the project by June.
ex.zh: 我們的目標是六月前完成專案。

aim.en: to try to do or get something

ex.en: The policeman aimed his gun at the man.
ex.zh: 警察把槍瞄準那個男人。

ex.en: The ad is aimed at young people.
ex.zh: 這則廣告是針對年輕人的。

aim.en: to point a weapon at a target, or to direct something at someone

ex.en: Perhaps you will seek his aid.
ex.zh: 也許你會去尋求他的幫助。

ex.en: The country received millions of dollars in foreign aid.
ex.zh: 該國獲得了數百萬美元的外援。

aid.en: help given to someone, such as money or supplies

ex.en: Doctor, please give this child first aid.
ex.zh: 醫生，請為這個孩子急救。

ex.en: Every office should have a first aid kit.
ex.zh: 每間辦公室都應該準備急救箱。

aid.en: basic medical help given at once to a hurt or sick person

ex.en: I was aided by a dear friend.
ex.zh: 一位好友幫了我。

ex.en: She aided her daughter in dressing.
ex.zh: 她幫女兒穿衣服。

aircraft.zh: 飛機、航空器（單複數同形）

ex.en: The airline plans to buy 20 new aircraft.
ex.zh: 這家航空公司計劃購買 20 架新飛機。

ex.en: All passengers must remain seated until the aircraft stops.
ex.zh: 飛機完全停止前，所有乘客必須留在座位上。

aircraft.en: a vehicle that can fly, such as a plane or helicopter

ex.en: Where is the United Airlines check-in counter?
ex.zh: 聯合航空的報到櫃台在哪裡？

ex.en: How are this airline's airplanes?
ex.zh: 這家航空公司的飛機怎麼樣？

ex.en: Which airline are you flying with?
ex.zh: 你搭哪一家航空公司？

airline.en: a company that carries people and goods by plane

ex.en: Scientists are working hard to put an end to AIDS.
ex.zh: 科學家們正努力終結愛滋病。

ex.en: I hope that some scientist will soon discover a cure for AIDS.
ex.zh: 真希望很快就有科學家找到治療愛滋病的方法。

ex.en: AIDS is caused by a virus called HIV.
ex.zh: 愛滋病是由一種叫做 HIV 的病毒引起的。

aids.en: a serious disease that attacks the body's ability to fight illness

ex.en: The documents were sent by airmail.
ex.zh: 文件已用航空郵件寄出。

ex.en: Airmail usually reaches overseas clients faster.
ex.zh: 航空郵件通常能更快送達海外客戶。

ex.en: I'd like an aisle seat, please.
ex.zh: 請給我靠走道的位子。

ex.en: Would you like a window or aisle seat?
ex.zh: 你想要靠窗還是靠走道的座位？

aisle.en: a narrow path between rows of seats or shelves

ex.en: The air conditioner has got out of order.
ex.zh: 冷氣壞了。

ex.en: Don't you think the air conditioner is turned up too high in here?
ex.zh: 你不覺得這裡冷氣開太強了嗎？

ex.en: The air conditioner in the lab is broken.
ex.zh: 實驗室的冷氣壞了。

air conditioner.en: a machine that keeps a room or building cool

ex.en: The president's aide handed him a note.
ex.zh: 總統的助理遞給他一張紙條。

ex.en: She works as a teaching aide at a primary school.
ex.zh: 她在一所小學擔任教學助理。

ex.en: AI can help translate languages and answer simple questions.
ex.zh: 人工智慧可以幫忙翻譯語言和回答簡單的問題。

ex.en: Many companies are using AI to speed up their work.
ex.zh: 許多公司正利用人工智慧來加快工作速度。

ex.en: She is studying AI at a university in the city.
ex.zh: 她在城裡的一所大學研讀人工智慧。

ex.en: The nurse made sure the patient's airway was clear.
ex.zh: 護理師確認病人的呼吸道通暢。

ex.en: A piece of food blocked his airway and he began to cough.
ex.zh: 一塊食物堵住了他的呼吸道，他開始咳嗽。

ex.en: Cold air can irritate the airways of people with asthma.
ex.zh: 冷空氣可能刺激氣喘患者的呼吸道。

ex.en: This airway is one of the busiest in Asia.
ex.zh: 這條航線是亞洲最繁忙的航線之一。

ex.en: Pilots must follow the assigned airway across the mountains.
ex.zh: 飛行員必須沿著指定的航線飛越山區。

ex.en: The small airfield only has one short runway.
ex.zh: 這座小機場只有一條短跑道。

ex.en: Planes took off from the airfield every morning.
ex.zh: 飛機每天早上從這座機場起飛。

ex.en: The plane was airborne ten minutes after leaving the gate.
ex.zh: 飛機離開登機門十分鐘後就升空了。

ex.en: Some viruses are airborne and spread through coughing.
ex.zh: 有些病毒會透過空氣傳播，例如咳嗽時散播。

ex.en: Rest and warm tea are good for minor ailments like a cold.
ex.zh: 休息和喝熱茶對感冒這類小毛病很有幫助。

ex.en: Her grandfather suffers from several age-related ailments.
ex.zh: 她的祖父有好幾種與年齡有關的病痛。

ex.en: The living room is bright and airy.
ex.zh: 客廳明亮又通風。

ex.en: We rented an airy apartment near the park.
ex.zh: 我們租了一間靠近公園、通風良好的公寓。

ex.en: He gave an airy wave and walked away.
ex.zh: 他漫不經心地揮了揮手就走了。

ex.en: She answered the question in an airy tone.
ex.zh: 她用輕描淡寫的語氣回答了這個問題。

ex.en: She stayed home to take care of her ailing mother.
ex.zh: 她留在家裡照顧生病的母親。

ex.en: The government tried to save the ailing economy.
ex.zh: 政府試圖拯救疲弱不振的經濟。

ex.en: The airliner landed safely despite the strong wind.
ex.zh: 儘管風很大，客機還是平安降落了。

ex.en: A huge airliner flew over our house this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上一架大型客機從我們家上空飛過。

ex.en: Store the cookies in an airtight container to keep them fresh.
ex.zh: 把餅乾放在密封容器裡才能保持新鮮。

ex.en: The jar has an airtight lid.
ex.zh: 這個罐子有個密不透氣的蓋子。

ex.en: The lawyer presented an airtight case against the company.
ex.zh: 律師提出了一個無懈可擊的案子來指控那家公司。

ex.en: She had an airtight excuse for being late.
ex.zh: 她遲到的藉口天衣無縫。

ex.en: The airman saluted as the flag was raised.
ex.zh: 升旗時，那位空軍士兵敬了禮。

ex.en: An airman checked the plane before takeoff.
ex.zh: 一名空軍士兵在起飛前檢查了飛機。

ex.en: The astronauts waited in the airlock before going outside.
ex.zh: 太空人在出艙前先在氣閘室等待。

ex.en: The submarine has an airlock for divers.
ex.zh: 這艘潛水艇設有供潛水員使用的氣閘室。

ex.en: The damp room needs an airing before we move in.
ex.zh: 這間潮濕的房間在我們搬進來前需要通通風。

ex.en: Give the blankets a good airing in the sun.
ex.zh: 把毯子拿到太陽下好好晾一晾。

ex.en: Whatever ails you, a good rest will help.
ex.zh: 不管你哪裡不舒服，好好休息都會有幫助。

ex.en: The company is ailing and needs new ideas.
ex.zh: 這家公司狀況不佳，需要新的點子。

aires.zh: 艾利斯（見 Buenos Aires 布宜諾斯艾利斯）

ex.en: Buenos Aires is the capital of Argentina.
ex.zh: 布宜諾斯艾利斯是阿根廷的首都。

ex.en: The flight to Buenos Aires takes more than twelve hours.
ex.zh: 飛往布宜諾斯艾利斯要花十二個多小時。

ex.en: The plane entered the country's airspace at noon.
ex.zh: 飛機在中午進入該國領空。

ex.en: Heavy storms closed part of the airspace over the city.
ex.zh: 強烈風暴使該城上空部分空域關閉。

ex.en: The town was damaged by an airstrike last year.
ex.zh: 這個城鎮去年在一次空襲中受損。

ex.en: The government warned of a possible airstrike.
ex.zh: 政府警告可能發生空襲。

ex.en: The small plane landed on a dirt airstrip in the jungle.
ex.zh: 小飛機降落在叢林中的泥土跑道上。

ex.en: The village built an airstrip to receive medical supplies.
ex.zh: 村子蓋了一條簡易跑道來接收醫療物資。

aintree.zh: 艾因特里（英國賽馬場所在地）

ex.en: The Grand National horse race is held at Aintree every year.
ex.zh: 大障礙賽馬每年都在艾因特里舉行。

ex.en: Aintree is near the city of Liverpool in England.
ex.zh: 艾因特里位於英格蘭利物浦市附近。

ex.en: We wandered aimlessly through the streets of the old town.
ex.zh: 我們漫無目的地走在舊城區的街道上。

ex.en: He scrolled aimlessly on his phone for an hour.
ex.zh: 他漫無目的地滑了一個小時的手機。

ex.en: The boat drifted aimlessly across the lake.
ex.zh: 小船漫無目的地漂過湖面。

ex.en: The airframe of the plane is made mostly of light metal.
ex.zh: 這架飛機的機身主要是用輕金屬做的。

ex.en: Engineers checked the airframe for cracks.
ex.zh: 工程師檢查機身有沒有裂縫。

ex.en: The engine and the airframe are built by different companies.
ex.zh: 引擎和機身是由不同的公司製造的。

ex.en: Open the window to improve the airflow in the room.
ex.zh: 打開窗戶讓房間的空氣流通更好。

ex.en: The fan increases airflow around the computer.
ex.zh: 這個風扇增加了電腦周圍的氣流。

ex.en: The airlift brought food to the cut-off town.
ex.zh: 空運把食物送到被隔絕的城鎮。

ex.en: Doctors organized an airlift of medical supplies.
ex.zh: 醫生們安排了醫療物資的空運。

ex.en: Rescuers airlifted the injured hikers to a hospital.
ex.zh: 救援人員用直升機把受傷的登山客送到醫院。

ex.en: The army will airlift water to the flood area.
ex.zh: 軍隊會空運飲水到水災地區。

ex.en: He spent the afternoon in aimless wandering around the town.
ex.zh: 他整個下午都在鎮上漫無目的地閒晃。

ex.en: After losing his job, he felt aimless and tired.
ex.zh: 失業後，他覺得人生沒有方向、很疲憊。
